primaryFlowObject.name: priorBusinessDayReportedUnitChangeWithOperationalAdjustments
primaryFlowObject.interpretation: For a T-day PCF decision context, ISSUES-DIFF is a lagged T-1 operational unit-change state by design, not same-day T flow.

clockContract.issuesDiffObservation: T-1 initial-review net creation/redemption with T-2 failure reversals and T-1 conversion adjustments
clockContract.tDayUpdate: PCF may be updated/retransmitted on T before the creation/redemption cutoff

taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.existingInventory: Applicants/APs may deliver pre-existing holdings; creation need not cause new market purchases.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.collectiveInKindCreation: Up to three applicants may pool existing holdings for an in-kind creation.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.minimumInKindBasket: With issuer approval, an AP may initially deliver at least 90% of the required stock-basket market value and later buy or borrow shortage shares by the next business day.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.cashSubstitution: Specific PCF constituents may be replaced by cash under allowed conditions.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.pcfVersioning: T-day PCF can be updated/retransmitted; same-generation version/use-date/hash must be preserved.
taiwanExecutionIdentifiabilityGuards.conclusion: Units delta plus PCF can support MODELED_PRIMARY_BASKET_EXPOSURE, not ACTUAL_STOCK_PASSIVE_FLOW.

crossModuleOwnership.D11_14: index event identity, announcement/effective clocks and event lifecycle
crossModuleOwnership.D06_16: creation/redemption, AP, premium-discount, tracking and underlying-liquidity mechanics
crossModuleOwnership.antiDoubleCount: One event/units primitive receipt is referenced downstream; it does not create multiple directional votes.

falsification: Announcement date T with unit observation date T-1 is expected under the official PCF workflow and is not stale by itself.
T-1 unit change is not same-day T fund flow.
Zero reported unit change does not prove zero gross creation/redemption.
Positive reported unit change does not prove every constituent was purchased in the secondary market.
PCF basket obligations do not identify AP inventory sourcing or actual execution timing.
Current prospective pages do not establish a complete immutable historical archive.

maturityDecision.reason: Clock semantics are corrected and the first genuine T-decision prospective receipt is identified, but independent multi-date version stability is still required for L3.

exactNext: Capture the next independent trading-date T-decision PCF before the after-market decision window, storing both T announce/use date and T-1 unit-observation date plus T-day update/version state.
